pages.title: Gen-Z SIM and promotions
pages.body: New eligible users born between 1997 and 2012 with NID may obtain Gen-Z SIM. Existing eligible users may access promotional offers through My Teletalk app or *111# but do not migrate to the Gen-Z base tariff and do not receive new-SIM startup benefit. For a new customer, SIM is 150 BDT. Do not promise current eligibility without operator verification.

pages.title: Agami education SIM
pages.body: Special education SIM with SMS registration via 16222 using SSC board, roll and year. Teletalk sends ID and OTP; applicant presents ID, OTP, NID and SSC admit card/certificate/marksheet at customer care. SIM cost on page Tk 100; one-time startup bonus requires recharge Tk 100 after activation. Exact student qualification must be checked on the official page.

pages.title: Bornomala SIM for students
pages.body: Student-focused Teletalk Bornomala SIM. Registration by SMS to 16222 with SSC details. Customer care requests ID, OTP and NID after registration. SIM price listed Tk 200; first Tk 50 recharge after activation triggers the described one-time startup bundle. Official conditions required.

pages.title: Oporajita women customer SIM
pages.body: Oporajita package is only for women customers. Migration requires customer-care contact. Special data offer is limited to the first three months after package activation; current 1GB special price differs across official pages and is quarantined. SIM price shown Tk 200. Avoid confirming subscriber eligibility from self-declaration alone.

pages.title: Mayer Hasi stipend mother SIM
pages.body: Mayer Hasi is a free CSR SIM for mothers of primary education stipend recipients; not for ordinary sale. Tk 29 recharge triggers 60 minutes plus 1 GB data, 15-day validity. Special 1GB Tk 9 first-three-month offer described on official page. Migration uses MH plus stipend account information to 556; never request account or NID numbers in chatbot.

pages.title: Professional Package eligibility
pages.body: Teletalk Professional Package for approved professionals with association ID and registration number; applicant presents evidence and NID at customer care or corporate wing. Each professional only one SIM per NID. Professional-only data and combo packs should not be recommended as generally eligible.

pages.title: Closed SIM reactivation eligibility
pages.body: Closed SIM offers are only for selected inactive customers under operator-side criteria. Eligibility must be checked using official *155*desired mobile number# procedure or official website; this application does not check subscriber eligibility. Two offers shown, each usable only once during campaign, no unused benefit carry-forward.

pages.title: Teleplan custom bundle
pages.body: Teleplan is an online package builder where users choose internet, voice, SMS and validity. Price is dynamically calculated by official interface. This project does not invent or calculate a Teleplan price; verify it on the official page.

pages.title: Value-added Teletalk services
pages.body: The official Teletalk VAS section lists emergency balance, balance transfer, missed-call alerts, call management, TeleTune, bill payment, entertainment and related services. Each service has its own conditions; visit linked official detail pages to verify tariffs and activation.

pages.title: Official Teletalk site map and categories
pages.body: The official sitemap lists prepaid packages, postpaid, corporate, roaming, offer sections, Internet special and regular data packages, modem, VAS, customer care centres and FAQs. A site link alone does not establish current offer eligibility or activation.

pages.title: Shotoborsho prepaid SIM and recharge benefits
pages.body: Shotoborsho official page describes a new SIM one-time Tk100 recharge benefit paid into balance with monthly bundle components over three months. Rate cutter mentioned on this page: Tk24 3 days and Tk44 7 days. Some existing Teletalk customers can receive other Shotoborsho offers, but the new SIM Tk100 bonus is excluded. Details must be checked for new versus existing customer status.

pages.title: Gravity postpaid connection
pages.body: Gravity is Teletalk postpaid. Official page lists 60 paisa/minute and ten-second pulse, Bangladesh SMS rates, security deposit and connection details. New connection price and credit limit are described there, but payment/eligibility must be verified before activation.

pages.title: Emergency balance eligibility and loan process
pages.body: Emergency balance on request by dialing *1122# or sending Loan to 1122. Loan availability is based on operator scoring and recharge/account history; customer-specific approval is not possible in this app. Service fees differ across official legacy and current-looking pages, so fee amounts are quarantined pending verification.

pages.title: Rate cutter voice offers
pages.body: Rate cutter promotions vary by package (Shadheen, Projonmo, Youth, Shotoborsho, Agami and Bornomala). Required recharge and validity vary and are published on official pages. Pulse descriptions differ between official rate-cutter listings; check exact current terms before quoting any rate.

pages.title: Teletalk customer care channels
pages.body: Teletalk official sitemap links to customer care centre, customer care points, call centres and service points. Subscribers should use current official contact information for SIM eligibility, migration or purchase confirmation; this app does not read operator systems.

pages.title: International roaming overview
pages.body: The official sitemap lists international roaming details, partner list, ISD rates and international SMS. This reviewed directory entry does not assert current roaming destinations or tariff; consult linked official service pages for exact current charges.

pages.title: eSIM and device availability directory
pages.body: Official Teletalk home page references an eSIM section and a router offering. Availability, compatible devices, replacement process and fees must be verified on dedicated current service pages.

pages.title: 4G FAQ and public service documentation
pages.body: Teletalk public sitemap lists FAQ sections including 4G FAQ and online-class FAQ, as well as data packages and contact services. A FAQ title alone does not establish a correct technical answer; review the linked page before quoting it.
